name: Fennville

climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, warm summer

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: Michigan's first AVA, in Allegan County in the southwest, set within the Lake Michigan Shore AVA. It was created on a petition from Fenn Valley Vineyards.
